description: Change or read a crewdroid emulator's environment: geo <lon> <lat> [alt], battery <0-100> [ac|unplugged], rotate <0-3>, sensor acceleration x:y:z, dark on|off, font <scale>, locale <pkg> <tags> (API 33+), gsm data <home|roaming|searching|denied|off|on>, gsm signal <0-31>, sms <from> <text>, call <number> [accept|cancel], show. Every setter reads the state back and errors on mismatch.

holdSeconds.description: gsm signal only: keep re-sending for this long

name: env
